description.value: Ashcroft Pool is a seasonal outdoor public swimming pool operated by the Village of Ashcroft, situated in one of the driest and hottest regions of British Columbia where summer temperatures regularly soar. The main pool features a graduated entry designed for wheelchair access, plus a wading area and waterslide, making it a true community hub during summer. For touring cyclists grinding through the arid Thompson River valley, this municipal pool is a compelling cooling-off stop.
